7th Armoured Div HQ^E, scan p.117, counter abbr '7', ID 'b', Arrives D. HEX CORRECTED 2026-07-27 in the 8.1c review repair, C3922 -> D3612: [60.41] Commonwealth Initial Deployment prints "D3612: 7th Armored Division (Det: all 7 Arm Div. units listed above)" -- an exact hex for this very counter, with every one of its units marked DETACHED and standing forward. The 8.1c pass instead co-located the HQ with three of those detached units at C3922, ~22 hexes from the printed hex, which put a non-combat HQ in the September-1940 frontier line and contradicted the setup rule twice over (wrong hex, and stacked with exactly the units the line detaches). This OOB only seeded 7th Armoured elements are three 7th Support Group units (the tank brigades/regiments are unseeded -- a pre-existing, much larger extraction gap, not fixed here). Explicit morale (Basic Morale +2): no FORMATION_MORALE entry keys '7th Armoured' today, so the 3 pre-existing siblings default to 0 -- flagged, not fixed, to stay surgical to the HQ ask.

4th Indian Div HQ^E, scan p.126, counter abbr '4 In', ID 'a', Arrives D. The chart prints the 'E' superscript on this row, which data/unit_stats.json older four-name flag omitted; corrected by the 8.1c pass. HEX CORRECTED 2026-07-27 in its review repair, C4131 -> D3615: [60.41] prints "D3615: 4th Indian Division (Det: 31st Field Arty and 7th In Bde)" -- again an exact hex, again with the units the 8.1c pass co-located the HQ with (IN 31 Fld - 4 In, at C4131) named as DETACHED by the same line. Its other elements phase in later by reinforcement (see reinforcements_campaign.json).

6th Australian Div HQ^E, scan p.124, counter abbr '6 Aus', ID 'a', Arrives D. MOVED 2026-07-27 (8.1c review repair) OUT OF data/reinforcements_campaign.json, where the 8.1c pass had given it an invented GT7 arrival by anchoring it to the division earliest seeded element. Both cited sources say at-start and neither says GT7: the chart Arrives column reads 'D' (= Deployed, begins the first Operations Stage of Game-Turn One on the map -- the chart own key, p.147/p.116), and [60.41] Commonwealth Initial Deployment prints "Cairo and/or Helwan (E 1430): In Training: 6th Australian Division (Less: 19 Aus Bdg; 2/1AFld Arty; 2/2AFld Arty)". Hex E1430 is Helwan, the second of the two the line offers and the only one it prints as a hex (rules/90 SUMMARY OF IMPORTANT LOCATIONS, data/city_forts.json, data/wells.json). FLAGGED, NOT FIXED: [60.41] deploys the WHOLE division there less three named units, and this OOB stages its battalions in from GT7 onward at Delta muster hexes -- a pre-existing reinforcement-schedule divergence from the setup rule, one this repair does not widen (only the HQ moves) and does not hide. 17.32 In Training is likewise untranscribed.

2nd New Zealand Div HQ^E, scan p.129, counter abbr '2 NZ', ID 'a', Arrives D. MOVED 2026-07-27 (8.1c review repair) OUT OF data/reinforcements_campaign.json for the same reason as the 6th Australian above, where the 8.1c pass had given it an invented GT2 arrival. [60.41] prints "Alexandria (E3613 &/or 3714): HQ: 2nd New Zealand Division; 4th NZ Bde (2 NZ); ..." -- and the 'HQ:' prefix there names THIS counter specifically. Seeded at E3613, the first of the two Alexandria hexes, the same one data/air_facilities_60_5.json and game/scenario.py already resolve that city to. Same flag as above: the division battalions still arrive on this file reinforcement schedule rather than at Alexandria on GT1.
